mapper.insert: MERGE INTO follow f USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS member_id, #{channelId} AS channel_id FROM dual) s ON (f.member_id = s.member_id AND f.channel_id = s.channel_id) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (member_id, channel_id) VALUES (s.member_id, s.channel_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follow WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND channel_id = #{channelId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS channel_id, c.name, AS live, c.title FROM follow f JOIN channel c ON c.id = f.channel_id WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY live DESC, f.created_at DESC, f.channel_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
